## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lourinhã, Portugal. It starts at 25 Rua Vale dos Dinossauros.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Inside Dino Parque Lourinhã, Portugal's largest open-air museum, you can take a journey back in time and walk among dinosaurs.
>
> Along a three-kilometer trail, you'll step back 420 million years and wander with 180 full-scale models of the most amazing animals to ever roam the earth – including a T. rex and a Supersaurus.
>
> There's five eras to walk through and the chance to see other unbelievable animals that inhabited the Earth, the oceans and the sky.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.05. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 190 ratings and 79 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
